title: BassetBlocks Core
description: Core mods for player use on the BassetBlocks server
body:
# The BassetBlocks Core Modpack
The BassetBlocks Core modpack serves as a foundational collection of mods designed to enhance the vanilla Minecraft experience without altering core gameplay mechanics. Its primary focus is on significant performance and rendering optimization, utilizing popular mods like **Sodium**, **Lithium**, and **FerriteCore** to reduce memory usage and improve frame rates. This pack also includes essential utility and library mods, such as **Fabric API** and **Mod Menu**, to ensure broad compatibility and ease of use. Additionally, it incorporates social features like **Simple Voice Chat** and the Hermitcraft-inspired **Status** mod to enrich the multiplayer experience. It is the essential starting point for any BassetBlocks adventure, providing a stable and smooth platform for further customization.

## Easy Customization
### Before Launch:
You can decide exactly what your experience will be like using the Modrinth App. Just go to your modpack's content list and use the simple toggles to turn any mod on or off for that session. Once you're happy with your selection, you hit "Play."![Modrinth App Toggle Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f03d7bbce57c2b3eb2fb14dca8c7e0951b7cdfc0.png)

### In-Game Menu:
When you get to the main menu, the Mod Menu mod adds a **"Mods" button** to your options screen. This is your in-game command center. From here, you can click on any mod and, if it has a gear icon, dive into its specific settings to tweak it to your liking.![Configure Mod Setting In Game With Mod Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d38fa77b590b5f32eca7e3f59ee97194f4d5fcd2.png)

## Our Purpose
The three BassetBlocks Modpacks—Core, Community, and Creator—are a user-friendly solution designed to simplify the process of installing and managing the mods, datapacks, and resource packs for use on the BassetBlocks server. Our purpose is to ensure all players, regardless of their technical expertise, can easily get started on the server with the correct and most current mods, eliminating the frustration of manual installation and versioning. The modpacks make it simple to stay updated with every Minecraft release, allowing you to focus on what matters most—playing on the BassetBlocks server.

## Tired of the hassle?
Tired of the complicated, time-consuming process of manually installing mods just to play on the BassetBlocks server? The BassetBlocks Modpacks are here to help. With a single click using the Modrinth App, you can get everything you need to jump into the action. No more searching for individual mods, dealing with compatibility issues, or struggling with updates. The modpack is built for convenience, making sure you have a seamless experience from the moment you launch Minecraft.

## The BassetBlocks Modpack Collection
### BassetBlocks: Core
The BassetBlocks: Core modpack is the essential modpack required to connect and play on the BassetBlocks server. It contains the absolute minimum of mods needed for core gameplay mechanics and performance, ensuring a smooth and stable experience. If you are new to the server or prefer a lightweight, vanilla-plus experience, this is the perfect place to start.

### BassetBlocks: Community
Building upon the Core modpack, the BassetBlocks: Community modpack is the recommended choice for the definitive BassetBlocks experience. It includes all essential mods plus a curated selection of popular, player-requested additions (mods, datapacks, and resourcepacks) that enhance gameplay with quality-of-life features, aesthetic blocks, and visual tweaks. This pack is perfect for players who want to enjoy everything the server community has to offer.

### BassetBlocks: Creator
Designed specifically for streamers and video producers, the BassetBlocks: Creator modpack is the all-in-one solution for content creation. It includes everything from the Core and Community modpacks, plus powerful client-side tools for recording, creating cinematic shots, and managing your visual presentation. If you plan on sharing your BassetBlocks adventures with an audience, this pack provides all the tools you need.

### BassetBlocks: ServerSide
This is a modpack collection for server administration purposes only and should not be downloaded by players. It contains all the necessary backend mods, datapacks, and configuration files that run the BassetBlocks world, manage performance, and provide support for player-side features. This pack runs exclusively on the server to make the magic happen for everyone. The modpack is available for admins that want to set up a server similar to BassetBlocks.

## Mods Included
  * **Cloth Config API:** A required library providing a unified configuration screen system for many mods.
  * **Datapack Injector:** An essential utility that allows for easy addition and management of datapacks within the pack.
  * **Fabric API:** The core library for the Fabric modding toolchain, essential for the vast majority of Fabric mods.
  * **FerriteCore:** Reduces the game's memory (RAM) usage for a more stable experience.
  * **ImmediatelyFast:** Improves client-side rendering performance for smoother visuals.
  * **Krypton:** Optimizes the Minecraft networking stack to improve connection performance.
  * **Lithium:** A general-purpose performance mod that improves game logic and server-side operations.
  * **Mod Menu:** Adds a user-friendly in-game menu to view installed mods and access their configurations.
  * **Simple Voice Chat:** Adds an immersive, proximity-based voice chat system to the game.
  * **Sodium:** A powerful rendering engine that significantly boosts FPS and improves graphical performance.
  * **spark:** A performance profiling tool used to diagnose performance issues on clients and servers.
  * **Status:** A social mod (popularized by Hermitcraft) that allows players to set and display a public status message.

# Purpose Statement
The BassetBlocks Modpack is a user-friendly solution designed to simplify the process of installing and managing the core mods and resource packs for the BassetBlocks server. Our purpose is to ensure all players, regardless of their technical expertise, can easily get started on the server with the correct and most current mods, eliminating the frustration of manual installation and versioning. This modpack makes it simple to stay updated with every Minecraft release, allowing you to focus on what matters most—playing on the BassetBlocks server.

# Appeal Statement
Tired of the complicated, time-consuming process of manually installing mods and resource packs just to play on the BassetBlocks server? The BassetBlocks Modpack is here to help. With a single click using the Modrinth App, you can get everything you need to jump into the action. No more searching for individual mods, dealing with compatibility issues, or struggling with updates. This modpack is built for convenience, making sure you have a seamless experience from the moment you launch Minecraft.

Whether you're a veteran player or brand new to the server, our modpack takes the hassle out of setup. Plus, it's not just for our server; anyone who wants a fantastic, curated collection of essential mods and resource packs can use it. Get the BassetBlocks Modpack today and spend less time troubleshooting and more time building, exploring, and having fun!

# Content Description
The BassetBlocks Core Modpack provides a collection of essential client-side mods and resource packs designed to enhance your gameplay experience on the BassetBlocks server.

## Mods
**Performance:** Boost your frame rate and reduce lag with optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, Krypton, and ImmediatelyFast.

**Visual Enhancements:** Enjoy a more dynamic and visually appealing game with mods like [EMF] Entity Model Features and [ETF] Entity Texture Features, which enable custom mob models and textures. Chat Heads adds player heads next to chat messages, making conversations more engaging.

**Utility & Quality of Life:** Improve your in-game experience with mods like Mod Menu for easy configuration, Armor Poser for more control over armor stands, and Simple Voice Chat for proximity-based communication.

## Resource Packs
This modpack includes the Fresh Animations resource pack, which gives mobs a complete animation overhaul. It also integrates a curated selection of resource packs from Vanilla Tweaks, including:

**3D Textures:** Adds 3D models to various blocks and items like Amethyst Crystals, Chains, Doors, Rails, and Vines to give them more depth and detail. It also applies a 3D effect to Items, Sun & Moon, and other decorative items.

**Farming Utility:** Enhances farming by showing different stages with Visual Cauldron Stages and Visual Composter Stages. It also provides a Fully Aged Crop Marker and Visual Sapling Growth to help you know when crops and trees are ready to harvest.

**Fixes and Consistency:** Corrects visual bugs and inconsistencies, such as fixing the Redstone Wire texture, ensuring Corrected Item Holding for tools, and making Hanging Sign Logs consistent.

**General Utility:** Provides helpful visual guides like a Brewing Guide and Hunger Preview. It also makes Unique Axolotl Buckets and Unique Painting Items to easily distinguish them.

**GUI:** Improves the user interface with a Colored Ping Indicator, Gray Hotbar Selector, and a Transparent UI. You can also use Numbered Hotbar to quickly see your active slot.

**Mining Utility:** Assists with mining by adding Ore Borders and a Fully Aged Amethyst Cluster Marker. It also provides Suspicious Sand & Gravel Borders and Visual Infested Stone (Items) to help you identify these blocks.

**More Zombies:** Gives zombies more visual variety by adding different player skins, including Alex Zombies, Steve Zombies, and others from the new default skins.

**No Pumpkin Overlay:** Removes the visual obstruction when wearing a pumpkin on your head.

**Quieter Sounds:** Reduces the volume of numerous in-game sounds, from Cave Sounds and Thunder to the sounds of individual mobs like Creepers, Ghasts, and Wither.

**Redstone Utility:** Makes working with redstone easier with Directional Hoppers and Directional Observers, Redstone Power Levels, and Visible Tripwires.

**Spinning Skull on Fire Painting:** Adds a fun, animated painting to the game.

**Unique Dyes:** Gives each dye item a unique appearance to make them more visually distinct.

**Variations:** Adds subtle, random variations to the textures of common blocks such as Cobblestone, Planks, Stone, and Villagers to make the world feel more natural.
